_note: Synthetic catalog metadata for UI review only (VITE_API_MOCK=true). No personal or FASTQ data. Kit names and upload limits are filled in from @portal/shared constants.

pipelines.name: Smart Checkup
pipelines.description: Simulated training analysis of a synthetic marker CSV with mock package recommendations. Training output only, not medical advice.

pipelines.name: wf-renamefastq
pipelines.description: Renames and optionally demultiplexes Oxford Nanopore FASTQ files with a local, offline Nextflow run of si-lol/wf-renamefastq. Test or public data only.

options.label: Demultiplex reads by barcode
options.description: Split the reads by barcode before renaming. Not available for barcode folders, which are already split.

options.label: Barcoding kit
options.description: The kit used for barcoding. Used only when demultiplexing.

options.label: Quality filter
options.description: Keep only reads that reach the minimum Q-score.

options.label: Minimum Q-score
options.description: Minimum read quality used by the quality filter.
